description: This file contains Redux Saga generator functions for executing and managing challenge tests, challenge preview updates, and challenge code execution in a coding learning platform.

methods.name: executeCancellableChallengeSaga
methods.description: Handles the execution of a challenge, including size validation and cancellation.

methods.name: executeChallengeSaga
methods.description: Main saga for executing challenge tests, updating console, and handling challenge completion logic.

methods.name: takeEveryConsole
methods.description: Listens to console log messages and updates the UI console.

methods.name: buildChallengeData
methods.description: Builds challenge data with error handling.

methods.name: executeTests
methods.description: Runs challenge tests with timeout and processes results.

methods.name: previewChallengeSaga
methods.description: Handles previewing challenge code, including error handling and code execution in preview or worker.

methods.name: updatePreviewSaga
methods.description: Updates challenge preview, handling different challenge types.

methods.name: updatePython
methods.description: Builds and runs Python challenge code.

methods.name: createExecuteChallengeSaga
methods.description: Creates saga watchers for challenge-related actions.

calls: call(reactor functions like getContext, select, put, take, fork, cancel, delay)
